zh-Hans: 上报当前失败的服务清单，服务恢复后告警能自动结束（包括探针重启期间恢复的服务）
Restart=always 服务的正常退出不再报成崩溃
反弹 Shell 按可执行文件合并；磁盘设备名（如 dm-0）完整
超长命令不再导致整包被服务端拒收
en: Reports the services that are failed right now, so their alerts end on recovery (also across agent restarts)
A clean exit of a Restart=always service is no longer reported as a crash
Reverse shells merge by executable; disk device names such as dm-0 stay whole
A very long command no longer gets the whole upload refused
